body:
Sorry about the other one folks, spelling was just too bad so I decided to post it again.  Still alot of bad grammar and stuff in this one but this one is at least readable.





                 All right. Where to begin? It all started about a month

                 ago, I saw the posting for a CT tourney so for the past

                 two to three weeks I had been bugging my buddy

                 and candidate for coolest man alive, mike gemme to

                 drive down there. Road trips are fun so he is like ok i

                 am in and since he was in so was steebo...steebo

                 and deck, deck and steebo. Kinda like batman and

                 robin, no more like Spiderman and harry

                 osborne(more on this later).



                 So Friday the 13th rolls around and I take the train to

                 hayes’ house and we meet up with pauly m and do

                 some playtesting. I playtest a solid wys and decide

                 to play it rather than my crusty dagobah. I play

                 huntdown racing for dark cuz i am a retard...friday is

                 kinda boring but whatever it was also sorta cool.

                 Well we drive to gemme’s house and just as we get

                 there mike’s sister and her hot friend

                 mckensie(mike’s sis is also hot for those of you who

                 have been living in a cave) walk out.  Anyway they are leaving

                 and because of hayes’ horrible parking they come

                 over and talk to us for 2 seconds and this is

                 great...mckensie is like "good luck tomorrow" and i

                 just wink...ds testing--sometimes you don’t need to

                 say anything.



                 Well I get inside his house and take a dump in his

                 bathroom which is connected to his sis’s room with

                 no lock so I am paranoid even though she isn’t even

                 home but whatever. I play mike a few times and he

                 eats all my guys with his sick rancourt deck that he

                 built because he saw this little kid eat like qui gonn

                 jedi luke and obi at a local the week before...I am

                 like play this deck tomorrow because it is hot. Very

                 good against anything that goes to tatooine and

                 good against space too because of court game

                 text...weakness could be qmc though.

                 Well mrs. gemme walks in and i am stunned by her

                 beauty, she is blond and hot...not unlike mrs. baroni

                 and i am shocked that i haven’t heard of her beauty

                 and great breasts...what the hell steebo!



                 So the plan at this point was to drive to andy klema’s

                 house that night and crash with him in ct so we

                 wouldn’t have to drive to ct in the morning.  So we

                 leave around 11 and have a cool time in the

                 car...hayes constantly pressures gemme to go

                 faster but gemme is chill and just takes it easy. we

                 go in the carpool lane, we drive through the ghetto at

                 70 mph. We try to mack girls but it is too late and

                 we can’t get out of the carpool lane anyway. We get

                 to klema’s house and end of story.

                 we play more games and i forget exactly but i win

                 about 2/3 of my games. me and gemme decide to

                 go to bed around 3 and we get put in his den which

                 might double as his meat locker but whatever....I go

                 get blankets for me and gemme and when i get back

                 Gemme is like, "did you get it?" as he waits on his

                 bed. I just burst out laughing because it is a like a

                 condom commercial and i honestly laugh for like

                 45 minutes. We try to sleep but it is way to cold so

                 around 7 Gemme and me get up but are still in bed

                 and Gemme is like, ’"wanna play a game" I am like

                 ok he is "like lets go"  He takes off blanket and has

                 decks in hand It was hilarious...you kinda had to be

                 there. but it was damn good.



                 After that we just chill to it’s time to go, we see this

                 teched out picture of Andy when he is three years old

                 but yet still has his beard so it is all good. We leave

                 kinda late and we hit traffic but we make it ontime

                 and I say we are all going to play ourselves and this

                 turns out to be prophetic.  Bah i am getting

                 bored...--the games



                 I am running solid wys w/o dont do that again

                 because I am dumb. And huntdown jizz for dark.



                 game 1--my dark, gemme’s wys solids.

                 Well it cool that we finally get to play each other but sucks one

                 of us will have to lose the first game...going into this I

                 feel kinda uneasy and think he will beat me because

                 he runs 3 a step backs and can play them from lost

                 pile. So I think about starting someting else and

                 not watto’s box but I say phuck it and lets go for the

                 gold(mistake #1). We it starts out relatively normal, I

                 invade the cantina and he takes space...he draws

                 very good for his race and I draw good but then draw

                 a 1 which sucks. The race is mad close and we are

                 trading drains, but here is the situation: If I win the

                 race I win the game. If he wins the race, the game

                 will be darn close. Well anyway he wins the race

                 despite some pretty teched out moves by me. I flip

                 him back though by getting maul in space, he needs

                 to find melas asap...he does after about 3 turns of

                 doing nothing but drawing. That is pretty much game

                 because  he has space and every time a try to duel luke he cancels it.

                 Very good game and i made close to no mistakes,

                 but huntdown podracing doesn’t fare to well when it

                 loses the race. Full loss by 14



                 Highs: great game...mike is the man.

                 Lows: nada.

                 Other: best feeling loss I have ever had.



                 so Hayes beats mr. @#$% himself shaun macarthy

                 by a bunch. Klema wins, steebo wins...bunch of

                 scrubs win(conn has a lot of really poor players, i

                 mean just there scrubs vs. our scrubs, our scrubs

                 will win).



                 game 2 i want revenge and get matched up against

                 some kid’s sycfa flip.

                 The kid knows the game well and blows alderan, but

                 i have the following out, mad ships at tatooine, i’ll

                 take the leader, han at the cantina, luke at the

                 middle docking bay with saber, and melas at the

                 other docking bay and run luke run in hand...damn that is good. drain 8 a

                 turn...game over in like 10 minutes.

                 Full win by 36.



                 Highs: winning

                 lows: does this prove anything? no.

                 other: I on the edge’d my luke to kill him so I could

                 retrieve more...



                 hayes won again, beating andy, gemme beat a kid.

                 steebo beat somebody who i guess was supposed

                 to be pretty good.



                 So 3rd game i get to play Brian Holingsworth (sp?) klema

                 tells me he’s good.



                 Well he is playing hayes’ pile with docking bays...I just

                 drop my guys to the race arena, so when i cause the

                 22 force swing, i all of a sudden have the only battle

                 ground on the table with vader, palp, maul and iggy...

                 he tries to fight me a few times with twass khaa..wtf?

                 I just dominate, he cant retrieve because of chybc...i

                 only activate 3 a turn but yet i dominate...Oh well.

                 Win by something like 36 or 38?

                 Highs: domination.

                 Lows: bah

                 Other: His deck (ls) had beaten a kid by 42

                 prior...hehe funny.



                 So gemme lost, steebo lost, klema won, brentson

                 won, hayes won.



                 In between games we go to mickey dees and i get a

                 big mac and it has a monoploy sticker on it...one of

                 the green ones. I figure i will put it on my nipple. I do

                 it and tell gemme he is like, yeah, tat is

                 funny...not! thinking how it is lame that i didn’t

                 actually do it. whatever. We get back and i get

                 paired up against steve valee’s hoth deck steebo

                 style.





                 Right off the bat i think i am @#$%ed because i don’t

                 play don’t do that again and without it it is a bad

                 matchup for me...well the game starts out alright

                 despite his mad undercover spies, i manage to get

                 out some drains and he drops down like 3 star

                 destroyers at tatooine and lateral damage, i barrier

                 but i am still @#$%ed at the system...about this

                 time, hayes ask me to take the sticker off my nipple

                 because he needs it. I do it while i am deploying jedi

                 luke and hand it to him....next thing i know,

                 everybody in the store, except my opponent, is

                 laughing like mad men...ok end of story.

                 Well i battle his walkers with jedi luke and @#$%

                 and am close to killing him with drains on hoth but

                 then i make the mistake of a lifetime and leave my

                 guys at the 5th marker, both han and luke, (my two

                 edge guys). So he ice storms and i say control from

                 lost pile to cancel it, he says ok but it still makes

                 ’em missing, i say no, we call over

                 somebody(mularky?) and sides with him...i look for

                 hayes or brentson to side with me but they left the

                 store or something..GAY. whatever, i still coulda won

                 but with his drains at tatoooine and 3rd marker he

                 makes short work of me...full loss by 12.

                 Highs: nada

                 Lows: plenty...i would have won by 20-25 if i don’t get

                 assed by ice storm. I made other mistakes too.

                 Other...32 rating points...no!



                 gemme lost again to somebody, hayes beat klema

                 again. brentson won, steebo lost.



                 I play steebo next...basically he is playing the hoth

                 deck, some shady @#$% was going on with him but

                 i wont go into that ’cuz i dont want to diss on my buy

                 steebo, plus it didn’t effect the outcome of the

                 game...He drops 2 ships early and lat damage on

                 theron nett...i lose him and like 8 force. I try to pull

                 the win outta my @#$% by playing celebration and

                 @#$% but he is too strong in space and all my

                 pilots are on the wrong ships(wtf?...dash on the

                 falcon, melas on wedge’s ship and wedge on the

                 skate). It was a cool game with alot of interaction but

                 basically every battle i either had to lose a guy or

                 2-3 force and i couldn’t handle it...late game garrison

                 wins him the game. Full loss by 18.

                 Highs: Playing steebo

                 Lows: I hate the hoth deck!

                 Other-hayes own again as did klema, gemme lost

                 again.



                 Well i am pretty depressed right now, i am 2-3 but i

                 knowi will win my last game becausei get paired

                 against some newbie...Not much detail on this one, i

                 duel luke, he loses 18 force, i win the race...win by

                 33?

                 Highs: nada

                 Lows: i had to explain to him what an objective was.

                 Other...see what i mean about ct?



                 So i finish 3-3...not very good but i had fun. My rating

                 will suffer a 60 point hit. So the tourney is over,

                 hayes wins it going 6-0 plus 151(!!!). brentson is

                 second steebo 3rd. mass in 1st and 3rd

                 place...ohhhhhyeaaah.



                 So we wrap up the tourney and i sell a qui gonn to a

                 kid for $30 so i can now eat...me, hayes, steebo,

                 deck, oakes(male striper/td down in conn...maybe

                 you’ve heard of him?) and klema head off to

                 applebees. On the way me and gemme have a

                 discussion about ds jedi testing for women vs. ls

                 testing for women. The conversation is cool esp

                 since we are in separate cars...i tell him he is turning

                 to the darkside and he is like, noooooo!

                 We get in to apple bees and our host/greeter is mad

                 hot and gemme gets his moves in with her and i give

                 him props for that. We take our seats and talk

                 testing and somehow racing gets mixed

                 in...everyone is all about how gemme is dominating

                 me but honestly our waitress is balz and both me and

                 gemme just dont bother after a while because she is

                 just plain nasty. Everyone is like gemme’s testing is

                 so much better, and i am like, maybe you lose a few

                 games with ds testing but, every once and a while,

                 you get the full win by 46  and it is all worth

                 while. Everyone laughs, then thinks about it and is

                 like, "true". We talk some more about how gemme

                 should be spider man and not tobey mcguire and

                 how steebo is harry osborne...klema’s gotta be flash

                 tompson, and i am james dean even though he has

                 nothing to do with spiderman.



                 We also realize(or i realize how teched out my

                 phone number is. Here is why, i say some how,

                 somewhere, there is game of star wars going on

                 where a guy is drawing nine battle destinies in this

                 oreder, 617, 566, 4046. Everyone is like you are

                 homo and i am all proud of my phone number

                 because all the numbers are legal destiny numbers. I

                 make fun of gemme and hayes because they break

                 the rules with just their area codes(978...what the

                 phuck is that? you got two illegal numbers in just

                 the area code!!)



                 Well we eat our food and gemme flashes the

                 applebees but read his tr for more info on that...we

                 leave and try to flash some more but it doesn’t really

                 work.



                 We head back to mass....we try to mack these

                 blondes in a convertible but some harley type dudes

                 get to em first(my ds testing buddies no doubt). We

                 eventually pull up to em but they ain’t that great so

                 we say phuck it. Ride home was cool though. Major

                 props to gemme for driving.

                 I ended up sleeping at hayes house on sat night and

                 am the king of saying card titles to match the mood

                 that night, like eric is putting cream cheese on

                 a baggle and i am like, you may start your

                 landing...i dunno, it was good. Next morning i go to

                 the train station and go back to my house and sleep.

                 good weekend.



                 major props--

                 Mike gemme, you cool man, nice game we had, you

                 owned me this weekend. Good stuff driving too altho

                 i offered to help you out.



                 Props-

                 hayes-you cool man. i have your shirt now.

                 steebo-you damn good at this game now...time to

                 beat hayes.

                 oakes-you mad cool...run more trs, tell mullarky to

                 go back to the minors.

                 jess gemme and mckensie--they are about to be

                 converted to the ds :)

                 klema--thanks for your house although your cats

                 suck...teched out beard dude.

                 everyone else--i cant think of slops...weekend

                 rocked. peace out







                 Side not to Mike, hayes, steebo and klema. Before

                 august 8th, we have to egt together and do

                 something, even if it ain’t cards. Think of something

                 ill to do...latazz.
